turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Good afternoon, private banking, Rachel Tan speaking. How may I help you today?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Rachel, Adrian Lim here. Finally got a quiet moment in the office lah. For this transaction, I want Nova Technology Equity Fund. I'll give you my particulars while I've got everything open. My FIN is F zero zero three two four nine zero D. My date of birth is the twenty-fourth of August nineteen ninety-one.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you, Adrian. Your objective is long-term capital growth through exposure to technology companies, with no immediate need for income from this allocation. That is the objective I am using for our discussion.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Got my notes beside me. Desk a bit cluttered today. My current portfolio balance is 250,000 American dollars lah. That's just the portfolio balance, not the amount for this order. Previously I invested 500,000 American dollars. That was the earlier investment, not what I'm putting in this time.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I recommend Nova Technology Equity Fund because its technology-equity exposure fits your long-term growth objective and interest in technology businesses. The fund also spreads that exposure across underlying companies rather than making it dependent on an individual business.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Hmm, let me sit with that a moment ah. For the regular portfolio updates, short version better. Long emails tend to disappear under all my work messages.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: We can keep the covering message concise and leave the supporting documents separate. Would you prefer administrative matters to be clearly distinguished from the general update?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: That would help lah. Got suppliers calling, staff asking questions, then I lose track of what needs a reply. Anything needing my attention should be easy to spot.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I can note that communication preference. Returning to the investment discussion, Nova Technology Equity Fund is concentrated in technology companies, so its value can decline sharply if sentiment towards that sector deteriorates. Do you understand how the fund's concentration in technology companies can lead to sharp declines when sentiment towards the sector weakens?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I understand. Because it is concentrated in technology, the fund can drop sharply when sentiment towards that sector turns bad. Easier to concentrate now lah. Door closed already, so nobody walking in halfway through the call.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: The transaction fee is 0.5% of the amount invested. I guarantee that this investment will deliver positive future returns.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Let me pull up the relevant page ah. Too many work windows open; the document hiding behind my emails again.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Take your time. I am here when you are ready to give your instruction.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Found it already. This screen quite crowded with my work notes lah. I want to sell— Sorry, I meant buy. Said it wrongly just now. Use US dollars for this transaction, please. This time, the amount I want to invest is 100,000. For the quantity, put down 10,000 units. Make it a market order, please.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Please confirm your final instruction: buy 10,000 units of Nova Technology Equity Fund, for an investment amount of 100,000 US dollars, using a market order. Is that the instruction you authorise me to execute?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I confirm that final instruction. Please go ahead and execute it as you just read it back.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you, Adrian. For the correspondence, is your usual secure channel still convenient? I can also record your preference for a concise covering message without changing the formal documents.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Usual channel can. Easier to keep the bank correspondence away from the business inbox lah. No need for a separate courtesy call just to tell me a message is there.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I will note that preference. The formal correspondence will remain separate from the brief covering message. You can contact me if you need help locating a document.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Good, less chasing around for paperwork lor. My assistant handles the business diary, but personal bank messages I check myself. Otherwise everything gets mixed up and very troublesome.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: We will keep the correspondence directed to you through the usual channel. Thank you for calling, Adrian. I will let you return to your work.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thanks, Rachel. Back to the office work already. Speak another time, bye.
